about: A control that runs an action when pressed, and a square variant that holds one icon.

disabled.about: A disabled button keeps its size in every look and ignores presses.
disabled.title: Disabled

effect.about: A halo in the palette's solid at half opacity. `glow` holds still and `pulse` breathes. Every button also runs a ripple from the press point without an effect set.
effect.title: Effects

elevation.about: A raised button lifts under the pointer and drops back towards the page when pressed.
elevation.title: Elevation

palette.about: The eight semantic palettes in every look. A palette sets the colors a look reads, so a theme moves every button that uses it.
palette.title: Palettes

pressed.about: A toggle is a button with `aria-pressed`. The recipe fills it while the attribute is true, so the fill matches what a screen reader announces.
pressed.title: Pressed

shape.about: The square shape holds one icon. `IconButton` sets it by default and requires an accessible name.
shape.title: Square

title: Button

variant.about: Every shared look plus `glass`, at every size. A look reads the palette, so a palette or a theme moves every look at once.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
